gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve a list of custom field configurations for my Jira project so that I can ensure all fields are set up correctly.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of custom field configurations, including field IDs, names, and their respective settings.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get the configuration details of a specific custom field by its ID or key to understand how it is set up for different contexts.
gold.ideal: The API should return the configuration details of the specified custom field, including context settings and applicable projects.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to update the configuration of a custom field to modify its context settings for better project alignment.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the custom field configuration and return a confirmation message along with the updated settings.
